residency_notes: Fireworks defaults deployments to the GLOBAL multi-region and supports US, EUROPE, and APAC multi-region groupings plus selected single regions. Single-region placement is a deployment-level control and should not be inferred for serverless routes.
prompt_training_notes: Fireworks says open-model inference prompts and generations exist only in volatile memory and are not persistently logged without explicit opt-in; metadata is still logged and prompt caching may use volatile memory. Its Responses API stores conversation data by default for up to 30 days unless store=false is sent. No training opt-out action is needed unless an account has previously opted in.
